components.name: Primary Button (Dark)
components.description: Primary CTA on charcoal sections; Lifted Sage fill with ground text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-dark { background: #8D9068; color: #14160F; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { background: #9EA080; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141,144,104,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Primary Button (Light)
components.description: Primary CTA on bone sections; Clinic Sage fill with cream text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-light { background: #5F6243; color: #EDECE2; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary-light:hover { background: #6B6F49; } .ds-btn-primary-light:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(95,98,67,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary-light:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action; transparent with a sand border. Never a third button style.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #B7B397; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border: 1px solid #B7B397; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(183,179,151,0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(183,179,151,0.3); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Editorial tile: photograph, service name in Fraunces, tabular price, quiet Book link. Flat at rest, floats on hover.
components.html:
Deep Tissue Massage

from £50

components.css: .ds-service-card { background: #1B1E15; border: 1px solid #2C3021; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(20,22,15,0.45); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-service-media { aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#2C3021,#43462C); } .ds-service-body { padding: 2rem; } .ds-service-name { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #EDECE2; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-service-price { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #9DA089; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; } .ds-service-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: #B7B397; text-decoration: none; } .ds-service-link svg { transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-link svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Price Menu Row
components.description: Restaurant-menu price row: name left, tabular price right, sand hairline rule. No offer banners.
components.css: .ds-price-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(183,179,151,0.3); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #EDECE2; } .ds-price-name { font-size: 1.0625rem; } .ds-price-value { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; color: #B7B397; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Transparent field, 1px line, label above, sage focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #9DA089; } .ds-input { background: transparent; color: #EDECE2; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #2C3021; border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7154; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #8D9068; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141,144,104,0.25); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Minimal nav link, cream default, sand underline on hover, cream active.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: #EDECE2; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 2px; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; width: 0; background: #B7B397; transition: width 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-active::after { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview: The whole system is the feeling of stepping into a warm, low-lit treatment room after a hard day in central London: linen, oil, quiet, and skilled hands. It is dark-first and cinematic, a warm near-black ground that lets the clinic's real sage green read as premium, with light treatment-room interludes for warmth. The register is brand, so feel outranks density. Underneath the calm sits quiet expertise, carried through restraint rather than noise: concrete prices and services over superlatives, discretion over display. The colour is committed: sage carries the identity on charcoal, with a single warm sand accent.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, cinematic ground with warm light interludes
Committed sage-green identity on tinted charcoal, one sand accent
Editorial serif (Fraunces) over clean humanist sans (Hanken Grotesk)
Generous, varied spacing; low density; one idea per screen
Legitimacy and discretion above all; calm as the deliverable

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sand is the only accent, used on kickers, hairlines, and secondary borders, never as a fill or as body text on dark. Its scarcity keeps the sage identity dominant.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: Never #000 or #fff. Every neutral tints toward sage. If a value looks flatly grey, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Two-Line Headline Rule
rules.body: The hero headline never exceeds three lines. Widen the container and reduce size before letting it wrap to four.

rules.name: The Serif-Sans Divide Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for display and names only; Hanken carries all body, UI, and labels. Never set body copy in the serif. Inter and default Poppins are prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears only as a response to state (hover, focus) or to lift photography off the ground, never as decoration.

dos: Do keep the committed sage identity (#5F6243 / #8D9068) grounded on warm charcoal (#14160F), with warm bone (#EAE9DF) light interludes.
Do set display and names in Fraunces, everything else in Hanken Grotesk.
Do use real prices, services, testimonials (Sam, Daren, Angela, Jakie, David), address, and hours. Concrete over boastful.
Do keep one quiet, ever-present path to booking, especially the mobile phone/Book action.
Do give sections big, varied vertical breathing room (clamp(5rem, 12vh, 10rem)).
Do keep motion ease-out and under 250ms for UI; honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't go clinical and cold, no harsh whites, medical stiffness, or stock doctor imagery.
Don't read as a cheap massage parlour, no neon, seedy, suggestive, or bargain-bin cues.
Don't use the busy spa cliche, no pink/lavender, lotus flowers, hot-stone stock, or cluttered discount banners.
Don't look corporate or templated like the site this replaces, no SaaS or website-builder feel.
Don't reproduce the old site's fake 0+ awards / 0+ clients counters or its leftover Ginkgo Health Clinic template copy.
Don't use pure #000/#fff, gradient text, background-clip:text, side-stripe (border-left) accent cards, nested cards, or emojis as icons.
Don't set sand as body text on dark, or let the hero headline wrap past three lines.
